meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Spotlight
meta.description: To welcome freedom is to also welcome death.

units.rawText: The food bathes in the light. The food is constantly being repaired.
units.displayText: The food bathes in the light. The food is constantly being repaired.

spans.text: The food bathes in the light. The food is constantly being repaired.

units.rawText: If it is repaired, then I'll eat it. I'll eat it until it can't be repaired anymore.
